bucket.description: The bucket of the resource Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
bucket.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

location.description: The location of the resource. The supported locations are: global, us-central1, us-east1, us-west1, asia-east1, europe-west1. Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to. If not specified, the value will be parsed from the identifier of the parent resource. If no location is provided in the parent identifier and no location is specified, it is taken from the provider configuration.
location.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

name.description: Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
name.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

parent.description: The parent of the resource. Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
parent.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

policy_data.description: The policy data generated by a `google_iam_policy` data source.
policy_data.rationale: Carries a complete, free-form IAM policy document. Meaningfully constraining an arbitrary embedded policy with a generic platform rule is impractical, so it is out of scope.
